iStats
Description
The iStats commands allow you to interact with the powerful new (as of
v11.0.0) stats interface available within BIG-IP.
Users can create an arbitrary number of iStats (although there is a
practical limit of 5,000-10,000 iStats)
iStats do not have to be preconfigured or predefined, they can be
built on the fly, effectively
Any consumer of iStats (even iRules) will always get the global view
(meaning, not on a per-TMM basis, but rather aggregated over all stat
producers)
iStats can be both read and modified by the control plane, i.e.
tmsh
Command List
ISTATS::remove
- Removes the given Stat
entirely.
ISTATS::get
- Reads in the value associated
with the given key
ISTATS::incr
- Increments the specified
key by the given value.
ISTATS::set
- Set the given key’s value
within ISTATS
